verses.sanskrit:
सौतिरुवाच।
              नागाश्च संविदं कृत्वा कर्तव्यमिति तद्वचः। निःस्नेहा वै दहेन्माता असंप्राप्तमनोरथा॥१॥
verses.english: Sauti said: The Nagas, after a consultation came to the conclusion that they should obey their mother's command, for if her wish was not gratified, she, abandoning her love towards them, would burn them all.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्ना मोक्षयेदस्मांस्तस्माच्छापाच्च भामिनी। कृष्णं पुच्छं करिष्यामस्तुरगस्य न संशयः॥२॥
verses.english: If she was gratified, she might free them from the curse. They said:-“We shall undoubtedly make the horse's hair black.”

verses.sanskrit: तथा हि गत्वा ते तस्य पृच्छे बाला इति स्मृताः। एतस्मिन्नन्तरे ते तु सपत्न्यौ पणिते तदा॥३॥
verses.english: It is said that they then went and became hairs on the tail of the horse (Uchchaishrava). In the mean time the two co-wives laid the wager.
verses.bhavadeepa: द्वाविंशोऽध्यायः नागाश्च संविदं कृत्वेति द्वादशश्लोकमध्यायं केचिन्न पठन्ति । कांश्चिदत्रत्यान् श्लोकान्पूर्वत्रैव च पठन्ति । अन्ये तु पञ्चषान्पठन्त्यपीत्यत्र कोशशुद्धिं न प्रतीमः । संविदं मिथ आलोचनम् ॥२॥

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते पणितं कृत्वा भगिन्यौ द्विजसत्तम। जग्मतुः परया प्रीत्या परं पारं महोदधेः॥४॥
verses.english: And having laid the wager, o best of Brahmanas, the two sisters proceeded in great delight to the other side of the great ocean.

verses.sanskrit: कद्रूश्च विनता चैव दाक्षायण्यौ विहायसा। आलोकयन्त्यावक्षोभ्यं समुद्रं निधिमम्भसाम्॥५॥
verses.english: Kadru and Vinata, the daughters of Daksha, saw on their way the ocean, incapable of being easily disturbed.

verses.sanskrit: वायुनाऽतीव सहसा क्षोभ्यमाणं महास्वनम्। तिमिंगिलसमाकीर्णं मकरैरावृतं तथा॥६॥
verses.english: (But) greatly agitated all on a sudden by the wind. (It was) terribly roaring, full of Timingilas and Makaras.
And many thousands of other creatures of various forms; it was frightful with the presence of horrible monsters; it was inaccessible, fearful and terrible,

verses.sanskrit: आकरं सर्वरत्नानामालयं वरुणस्य च। नागानामालयं चापि सुरम्यं सरितां पतिम्॥८॥
verses.english: The mine of all gems, the home of Varuna, the beautiful habitation of the Nagas, the Lord of rivers,

verses.sanskrit: पातालज्वलनावासमसुराणां तथालयम्। भयंकराणां सत्त्वानां पयसो निधिमव्ययम्॥९॥
verses.english: The abode of subterranean fire, the home of the Asuras and many fearful creatures, the reservoir of waters.

verses.sanskrit: शुभ्रं दिव्यममर्त्यानाममृतस्याकरं परम्। अप्रमेयमचिन्त्यं च सुपुम्यजलसंमितम्॥१०॥
verses.english: It was holy, the great receptacle of the Arabrosia of the celestials, immeasurable and inconceivable, full of holy waters.

verses.sanskrit: महानदीभिर्बह्वीभिस्तत्र तत्र सहस्रशः। आपूर्यमाणमत्यर्थं नृत्यन्तमिव चोर्मिभिः॥११॥
verses.english: Filled with many thousands of and thus disturbed, dancing with its waves.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्येवं तरलतरोर्मिसंकुलं ते
              गम्भीरं विकसितमम्बरप्रकाशम्। पातालज्वलनशिखाविदीपिताङ्गं
              गर्जन्तं द्रुतमभिजग्मतुस्ततस्ते॥१२॥
verses.english: Such was the ocean full of liquid waves, (it was) vast as the sky, deep, lighted with the flames of subterranean fire, roaring; they (the sisters) passed quickly over it. great rivers
